metadata.title: Groupicorn — Texas IOP/PHP research package
metadata.purpose: Prototype research directory of physical intensive outpatient / partial-hospitalization candidates around practical Texas browsing catchments.
metadata.methodology: Provider/location/area entities are separate. Shortlists use distinct provider groups, local branches first, then explicitly named neighboring catchments. Selection order is for deterministic prototype display and is not a clinical quality ranking.
metadata.branding_note: This legacy Texas package now uses tracked official PNG assets for the refreshed RGV records. Older Texas records may still retain prototype favicon URLs pending source migration.
metadata.geocoding_note: Street addresses and ZIPs are stored; latitude/longitude are intentionally null so a later geocoder pass can be audited separately.
metadata.publication_warning: Internal research only. Verify current program availability, track eligibility, insurance, intake requirements, and accepting-patient status before public display or referral use.
metadata.research_note: 2026-09-22 focused Rio Grande Valley refresh: Edinburg and Harlingen candidates were checked against current provider pages and corroborating directories. Origins Recovery & Counseling was not duplicated because its current Harlingen IOP listing shares 2202 S 77 Sunshine Strip Suite E with the existing Cypress Lake outpatient record; resolve the provider/site identity before changing that location.
